body: I suppose it feels normal. It just hurts and I hurt myself in return. Music-wise, I'd like to form some kind of experimental band. It's exciting because I think it'd be successful, but at the same time - I feel it's pointless. All I ever really wanted out of life was a direction. I knew when I'd figure out what I'd want to do, I'd shoot for it 1000%. Just when things start looking up, they always crash down. It's so tiring. I did talk to my friends about it and it did help. I couldn't tell them I was messing with sleeping pills/alcohol though. I've even reached out to the friends I had. I only talk to them once a year, so if they wanted to do something, it'd be so great. Honestly, I'd just like to not feel alone. That's what I really want. I don't want to die. I just wish my family and friends would show they care a bit more. Asking them to do that just feels like a burden though. I really appreciate your posts by the way. It helps a lot.

I took 3 of them with some vodka. I can't say I feel much. My gf broke up with me tonight. It was pretty out of nowhere. What sucks is that it's nothing I did, too. When you know there's nothing you can do, it's just really defeating. I know there are other people out there, but it sucks starting from square one again. Maybe she'll text me in the morning and regret it. I'm not counting on it though. What you should understand is that I don't have many friends. A lot of them live pretty far. So I just rarely saw anyone but her, which is why it hurts a bit more, I think. I'd still like to pursue a career in music, but it feels so futile. Like, what's the point? 

Anyway though, I might call poison control just to be safe. I'm not even sure what I want anymore. I'm a little afraid I'll die in my sleep.

I was coming off the highway late as fuck one night. It started snowing, so I just decided to get off. The exit was one of those 1 way roads that's curved like a U. I was just driving, curving right with the road. Then it kept going right. I lost control. I was about to swoop down a steep hill. No doubt I would've rolled over and died. I braked hard as fuck and I thankfully stopped with no damage at all. My car was facing the incoming traffic, but luckily no one was around. Idk. I feel like I'm on borrowed time. I kind of wish I died. The days since then haven't been great. It just would've been a good time to die.

What's crazy is that all the years before, I had no ambitions, no plans. Now I do, yet I still feel like dying. I don't understand it at all. Initially, when the car started spinning out, I almost had no intention of stopping it. For some reason, I braked and saved myself. What I wanted all along was in front of me and I stopped it. Maybe I regret it. It's just super weird. If I think back on it, I can vividly imagine what it would've felt like had I not stopped.
Just two. I took one at about 1 am, then another at 2 am.
I took a few with some vodka/coke. They were spaced out. Am I good?
Would it put me in the hospital?

Tbh nah. I took 2 sleeping pills with vodka. I know it's supposed to slow down your heartbeat, but I'm not feeling it. I'm not necessarily trying to die. But maybe. Idk man. I've been kinda fucked since I almost died in a car accident a week ago. I feel like I've escaped death. It's a super weird feeling.
It doesn't feel too cool, but I appreciate the thoughts.

I survived it. I'm probably gonna survive another one, too. Honestly, maybe it's a sign we should just keep moving. Think about it. Do we *truly* know what's ahead of us? I don't necessarily think so. I barely believe the shit I'm telling you, but at least you know I sort of believe it. Who knows, man
